audience.programmeDescription: Leiden’s bachelor in Italian Language and Culture combines intensive Italian language study with linguistics, literature, film and cultural history. It includes research and a bachelor thesis.
audience.comparisonExplanation: The available curriculum evidence supports a partial view of the Leiden degree. The third-year choices and some progression requirements still need confirmation.

curriculum.limitation: The components shown account for 170 EC. Four options in the third-year choice list also appear in the second year. The remaining 10 EC of distinct options and the entry conditions for several advanced courses and the thesis need confirmation.

componentNotes.curr-component-24: 30 EC of open study, which can include an approved minor, exchange or placement.
componentNotes.curr-5603vbscry: 10 EC thesis with a required seminar. The current listing still refers to earlier language course names in its entry requirements.
componentNotes.curr-5603iclcy: 5 EC listed third-year option in Italian syntax and dialects. Entry requires B1 Italian and prior Italian linguistics or equivalent study.
